name: The Spirit of Books and Reading

sheet.name: The Spirit of Books and Reading
sheet.backstory: An infant genius loci born from a concentrated reservoir of vestigia in a bookshop basement; too newly formed to control its powers, it throws things about in lonely confusion.

custom_fields.value: Non-verbal; it does understand English, though, and its spelling ability is equivalent that of a five-year old
The smell of blood, the taste of plasticine, and the sensation of crossed legs and chicken feathers. MOV: 10 MP: - LUCK: -
